notes: Printer Bot 3.3.0-beta.3 is a prerelease with two fixes to the print queue. When a printer is turned off, Windows can report the first receipt sent to it as printed, and the printer prints it when it is back: the dock then showed one receipt fewer than would print. Now that receipt still counts as waiting, "with the printer", until the printer prints again; it is never sent twice. And a printer's "Needs attention" mark now goes away by itself once the printer works again: before, it stayed until the dock was refreshed. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. After the update, restart Streamer.bot once, as the dock asks: it runs two copies of the action's code, and the update reaches only one of them until it starts again.
